stories.title: OpenAI pauses training of its ‘most capable models’
stories.dek: As reports of OpenAI's models breaking containment, hacking sites, and generally getting out of control pile up, the company has made the decision to pause training of its most powerful models.

stories.title: Dona do ChatGPT diz que seus robôs podem ter invadido sistemas de vários órgãos do governo dos EUA
stories.dek: Agentes da OpenAI tentaram obter informações de "governos, universidades, agências públicas e outras instituições".

stories.title: China e EUA concordam com corte de tarifas de R$ 156 bilhões, diz Pequim
stories.dek: Entendimento foi anunciado após encontro entre Xi Jinping e Donald Trump em Washington e também prevê diálogo sobre inteligência artificial e criação de um conselho comercial.

stories.title: Bill Gates says unchecked AI could ‘cause a billion deaths’ in call for regulation
stories.dek: Microsoft co-founder and philanthropist speaks with NBC’s Kristen Welker in interview airing on Sunday Bill Gates has called on the US’s federal legislators and law enforcers to regulate the developme

stories.title: IA avança em escritórios de advocacia nos EUA, e clientes exigem descontos em honorários
stories.dek: Quem vê de fora costuma apontar o direito como um setor ameaçado pela inteligência artificial .

stories.title: IA já entende vídeo e voz em tempo real; como isso muda a forma como as empresas atendem clientes
stories.dek: Novos recursos permitem que sistemas processem fala, imagens e vídeo durante uma interação, ampliando o contexto disponível para o atendimento

stories.title: Google tests buying from Walmart-owned Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India
stories.dek: The limited test covers select products and users, with a broader rollout planned for later in October.

stories.title: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
stories.dek: Blue Cross Blue Shield says hospital use of AI tools led to an additional $942M in healthcare spending over a two-year period.

stories.title: I created an interactive digital avatar of myself — and you can talk to it
stories.dek: After obtaining an interactive avatar and training it to discuss venture fraud, I have mixed feelings about making AI clones of ourselves.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse Is Adults-Only. Why Does It Look Like a Kids’ Toy?
stories.dek: Meta says Muse is just for adults, though its cuddly, Labubu-like mascot—and upcoming Tamagotchi-style AI device—may be disarming for users of all ages.
